display_long_description:
Keko is a multiplayer VR horror experience that weaponizes nostalgia and realism to keep you on edge. Trapped in a glitched reality with your squad, you must navigate an environment that seamlessly twists between gritty, low-poly PS1-era aesthetics and terrifyingly crisp, high-quality modern graphics.

In VR, the terror is up close and personal. Team up, watch each other's backs, and try to survive as the world alters around you. What looks like a harmless pixelated shadow in retro-mode might become a living nightmare when the graphics shift.
